name: Caramel Biscuit & Cream Ice Cream
ingredients_raw: Caramel Ice Cream (89%) (Cream (35.4%), Caramel Base (24.0%) (Water, Dried Glucose Syrup, Milk, Sugar, Wheat Glucose Syrup, Salt, Natural Flavouring Substance: Vanilla), Condensed Skimmed Milk, Sugar, Water, Egg Yolk), Biscuit Pieces (11%) (Refined Wheat, Flour, Sugar, Edible Vegetable Oil (Coconut Oil), Edible Vegetable Oil (Rapeseed Oil), Icing Sugar, Concentrated Butter, Candy Sugar, Raising Agent (Sodium Bicarbonate), Emulsifier (Soy Lecithin), Salt, Cinnamon Powder.
